k: The Prophet ﷺ said: <1>"Zamzam water is for whatever it is drunk for."</1> (Ibn Majah {1}) and called it "blessed — a food that nourishes" (Muslim {2}); another narration adds "and a cure for illness" (al-Tayalisi, al-Bazzar). Drink your fill, face the qibla, and ask Allah for exactly what you need — knowledge, cure, forgiveness.
